Hi Carlos — thanks for sending these over. Quick checklist from our side (Finance copied):

- Required: W-9, voided check or bank letter (you sent both — perfect).
- Next step: Finance usually issues two micro-deposits to the account and asks vendor to confirm amounts. Alternatively, we can accept bank letter + voided check and skip micro-deposits if you supply a bank-verified ACH authorization form (DocuSign).
- Remittance format: our systems expect a single-line remittance that contains: PO#: <po-number> | Invoice#: <invoice-number> | Invoice Date: <YYYY-MM-DD> | Amount: <USD>. If you can include those four fields in the invoice email subject or first line of the invoice body, the auto-match will work.

Two asks for you now:
1) Can you sign the DocuSign direct-deposit form? I pasted the link below. Signing will allow us to fast-track and avoid manual micro-deposit confirmation.
2) Please confirm the exact account number (masked is fine in email; finance will get it via secure upload).

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/LM/direct-deposit/abcdef

Marissa — when you have a sec, can you confirm the micro-deposit flow and the amounts you plan if we go that route? Also note the target first payout on 2026-09-01; we need onboarding complete by 2026-08-25 for ops to schedule.

Best,
